versions.changelog:
results-statistics-convention-checker v1.0.0 – Initial release.

- Provides automated checks for the statistical reporting conventions in psychology Results sections, focused on APA style.
- Detects issues with reporting of descriptive statistics (M, SD), inferential statistics (t, F, χ², r, β), p values, effect sizes, and confidence intervals.
- Compares text against bundled best-practice and problem examples; assigns a rubric-based score (1–5) for reporting quality.
- Outputs detailed, itemized feedback — including problem evidence, example IDs, concrete revision suggestions (with Before/After), and prioritized recommendations.
- Targets only the Results section and does not perform statistical recalculation or check design/method choices.
